items.basis: The preferred workspace-preview on main is a mockup that never calls the API. The older apps/web research panel does drive the actual coordinator (apps/web/check-research.mjs passed: browser-created session, compiled graph plan, approved investigation, separate design approval, replay, 0 provider requests), but it is not the preferred interface.
Live calls held until a combined candidate passes the controlled lane.

Sessions differing only in the reviewed claim or allowance take different next actions from the acceptable sets: checked counterexample leads to a separately approved design review; no counterexample or no separation leads to clarification; missing inputs ask without science.
No child before the canonical decision; the dispatched child binds the approved review; forged, raw-command and actor-selection decisions refused; duplicate decisions create no extra child.

Worker killed (uncaught BaseException) right after child dispatch; worker --recover marks needs_reconciliation; explicit reconcile (idempotent; a new key is refused) resumes the same action, which completes with exactly one job and one scientific reservation.

F-SPRINT-REPORT-COMMENTARY: the agent's commentary exists in the publish_research_report acknowledgement but the downloaded report body has no explanation or recommendation field. Reported to A on PR #60.

A provider 429 after a completed Counterdex child (live code path, offline SDK) leaves the evidence record, native bytes (SHA-256 matches) and anchor downloadable, records provider_rate_limited and is not retried by later worker passes.

Backend behaviour passes: a 429 is one charged attempt with stable code provider_rate_limited, no second request, no controlled-policy fallback, no child; an exhausted allocation is refused before the SDK (provider_budget_exhausted / research_provider_allocation_exhausted). The pass condition also requires plain-language presentation; apps/web renders the raw code ('The last step stopped: provider_rate_limited'), and the preferred workspace does not call the API. Reported to B on PR #61.
Neither owner's branch had implementation commits when this baseline was recorded.
